title: Award Term and Covered Dates of Service, Patient Financial Assistance Program
content:
An award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program covers a span of dates of service. Under every tier, both the award term and the lookback are counted from the application date. The tier fixes how many calendar months the award runs from that date, how many calendar days before it dates of service are covered, and whether dates of service after the application date are covered.

| Tier | Counted from | Award term, calendar months from the application date | Lookback, calendar days before the application date | Dates of service after the application date, through the award end, covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Application date | 6 | 240 | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Application date | 6 | 240 | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Application date | 12 | 240 | Yes |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Application date | 12 | 240 | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Application date | 12 | 240 | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Application date | 12 | 365 | Yes |

## Points of reading

- The two 6-month tiers are the Financial Assistance 25% Discount and the Financial Assistance 50% Discount; every other tier runs 12 months.
- The Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment looks back 365 calendar days; every other tier looks back 240.
- Every tier covers dates of service after the application date, through the end of the award.
